en.summary: A CEX.IO referral promo: when a friend signs up through your link and completes a $100+ crypto purchase or fiat deposit, you both get a reward of up to 50 USDC (a dollar-pegged stablecoin). It runs until Nov 30, 2026, 23:59 UTC, only in the listed countries, and every qualifying friend adds another reward.
steps: Check that your country is on the promo’s list (see “Watch out”).
Send your CEX.IO referral link to a friend.
Your friend signs up on CEX.IO through your link before Nov 30, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
Your friend completes a crypto purchase or fiat deposit of $100 or more, also before Nov 30, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
Repeat with other friends: each friend who completes the steps adds another reward.

payout.when: The rules do not say when the reward is credited. They only say the promo closes Nov 30, 2026, 23:59 UTC and rewards go first-come, first-served.
payout.form: Up to 50 USDC for you and up to 50 USDC for your friend, per qualifying friend. The exact amount depends on your region, and there is no table of amounts by region. The rules do not say whether this is withdrawable USDC or a bonus with restrictions, so check the reward details on CEX.IO before counting on cash.
payout.how: The rules do not say where the reward appears or whether you must claim it manually. Check your CEX.IO account and the full terms (“Terms apply”).

watch: Only available in: the US, Cape Verde, Serbia, Albania, Kosovo, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jamaica, Azerbaijan, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Georgia, Armenia, Bahamas, Barbados, Mauritius, Saint Lucia, Antigua and Barbuda, Bermuda, Guatemala, Curacao, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Panama, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. Ukraine is not on the list.
Rewards are first-come, first-served, so they may run out before Nov 30.
“Up to 50 USDC” is the maximum; the actual amount depends on your region.
Your friend must sign up through your link and buy crypto or deposit fiat for $100 or more; a smaller amount does not qualify.
This is only the announcement: the full terms (“Terms apply”) may contain extra conditions not shown here.
The text says nothing about purchase or deposit fees; check them on CEX.IO before your friend puts money in.

faq.a: No. Ukraine is not among the countries where this promo is available. The full list is in “Watch out”.

faq.q: How many friends can I invite?
faq.a: No limit is stated: every friend who completes the steps adds another reward. But rewards are first-come, first-served, so they can run out.

faq.q: Does my friend have to buy crypto?
faq.a: No. Either a $100+ crypto purchase or a $100+ fiat deposit counts.

faq.q: What happens to my regular referral commission?
faq.a: It stays. The rules say your regular 30% referral commission keeps counting on top of this reward.

faq.q: Why is it “up to” 50 USDC and not exactly 50?
faq.a: The rules say the amount depends on your region. The announcement does not say how much each country gets.

faq.q: What if my friend signs up but buys crypto after Nov 30?
faq.a: The promo closes Nov 30, 2026, 23:59 UTC, so it is safest to finish every step before then. The text does not say whether actions after the deadline count.
